headline: Canvass and correct the final voter list for the November 3, 2026 General Election and certify mail ballot applications.
summary: The Canvassing Authority will canvass and correct the final voter list for the General Election on November 3, 2026. It will also certify mail ballot applications and handle other matters of concern.
items: Canvass and correct the final voter list for the General Election to be held on Tuesday, November 3, 2026
location: Town Hall Council Chambers, 180 High Street, Wakefield RI 02879
plain_text:
Posted on 10/5/2026 
 
Town of South Kingstown  
Canvassing Authority  
Regular Session Meeting Agenda   
Tuesday, October 13, 2026 at 2:00 PM   
Town Hall Council Chambers 
180 High Street 
Wakefield RI 02879 
www.southkingstownri.gov  
Walter A. Young, Jr., Chair 
Sarah L. Vaccaro, Vice Chair 
Elaine D. Shanley, Member 
  
1. Call to Order 
2. Approval of Minutes 
 A. September 21, 2026 
3. New Business 
 A. Canvass and correct the final voter list for the General Election to be held on Tuesday, November 3, 2026. 
 B. Certify mail ballot applications. 
 C. All other matters of concern. 
4. Adjournment 
  
 
NOTE: Individuals requesting American Sign Language interpreters or CART service must call the Town Clerk’s Office at 
401-789-9331 seventy-two (72) hours in advance of the meeting date. 
 
YouTube link: https://youtube.com/@skmiscboards/streams
